subject: gk
question: Which of the following was true with regard to the Green Revolution?

options.text: Its method of cultivation required less quantity of water
It involved use of organic fertilisers and pesticides
It involved use of high-yielding variety of seeds
It was targeted mainly at the pulses-growing areas

solution:
The correct answer is __**It involved use of high-yielding variety of seeds**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Green Revolution involved the use of **high-yielding variety of seeds**.
 
• These seeds were designed to increase crop production and were part of a package that included the use of chemical fertilizers and pesticides.
 
• The revolution primarily targeted the **rice and wheat-growing areas** of India to ensure food security.
 
• It significantly increased agricultural productivity in the country and transformed India from a food-deficient to a food-surplus nation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The Green Revolution was initiated in the 1960s and led by agricultural scientists like **Dr. M.S. Swaminathan**.
 
• It introduced modern agricultural techniques and practices to traditional farming in India.
 
• Despite its success in increasing food production, it also led to environmental concerns and the depletion of natural resources.
 
• It primarily benefited the more affluent farmers and regions, leading to disparities in agricultural development.
